name: Hoshibami Taiga
source: Captain of Sinostra and owner of the extravagant casino housed there. His impulsive and unpredictable behavior puts him in constant conflict with others. Though an uncannily skilled gambler, his money squandering causes violent arguments between him and his partner Romeo.
